method.search_pattern_construction: Stored authority surname plus all observed givens before lifespan; honorific-only components removed. Current full names formatted surname-first. No initials expansion or invented aliases.
method.change_from_planned_local_parse: Both direct public PDF byte requests403; stopped. Used already-acquired tool-parsed documents only. Did not re-open or retry original URLs after403.
method.screening_limit: Each full formatted native name submitted once to parsed-PDF find. Tool results can be broad, not reliably literal. Returned headers/entry fields reviewed manually for actual subject binding; empty/unrelated results are not a normalized complete-rawtext absence test.
method.body_reading_count: Six positively bound subject-entry segments plus four different-person entry segments used for two rejections;159 searches are not159 biographies read.
method.original_source_body_vs_raw_access: Tool-parsed original PDF text was available. Separate direct raw access403 does not turn parsed text into rawbytes, nor imply webpage/PDFbody200.
method.DOB: Six bound entries exact native day in header; no frozen native date or identity rewritten.
method.source_grade_role: S2 candidate person-birthplace support only; original DOB tiers remain frozen.
method.geography: No hemisphere, country, point/entity or coordinates assigned by this worker. Birthplace fields retain actual supplied qualifiers; membership/nationality/school/work/death/footer not used.
